# Journal

One dated entry per working day, append-only: a past entry is never changed (`brain journal add --title "..."`).
Decisions go to `notes/decisions.md` (ADR, `brain adr new`), the work to the graph (`notes/graph`, board
`notes/kanban_graph.md`).
